pre_registration: NONE. This is a PILOT, not the pre-registered battery.

pilot.what: The first phone sitting (3 September 2026, Robotics_Clips/), which failed the pre-registered protocol and is run here only as a disclosed pilot.
why_not_the_battery: Objects were rotated one zone per round by the owner, not placed from the committed tables; this placement record was written down from the footage on 5 September, before any detector ran on it, and is not a random draw.
Book was replaced by a Rubik's cube (not in the detector vocabulary) and CellPhone by a laptop; the pilot therefore grades Mug, RemoteControl, Bottle, Bowl and Laptop (five classes, 30 episodes).

Same-class fixtures stayed in the zones: a stack of books on the desk (zone 2), steel bowls and a teal cup on the marble table (zone 4), a candy dish, a soap bottle and bagged water bottles at the island (zone 3), a second laptop in the background of some desk clips. Wrong commitments caused by them count as measured.
Portrait HEVC with a rotation tag, transcoded to baked-portrait H.264 30 fps.
pilot.never: the paper's headline result; reported only as a labelled pilot.

scope: This is a PERCEPTION-AND-COGNITION test on real camera pixels, NOT a robot result. Nothing moves: a person carries a phone to six fixed zones in one room and records a short clip of each. The engine chooses which zone's clip to look at next, accumulates OBSERVED and ABSENT_FROM claims, and commits to a zone. No navigation, no manipulation, no autonomy over a physical body is claimed or measured.
generator: scratch script from the frame sheets, not scripts/make_phone_manifest.py

protocol.room: one room, six fixed zones, recorded by hand
protocol.placement_rule: random.Random(seed).shuffle([1..6]); the shuffled list read off against targets in their fixed manifest order
protocol.recording_order: 1 -> 6 in every round (verified from embedded creation times)
protocol.re_record_rule: If an object will not sit in its zone, or is knocked over, or the clip is unusable: re-record THAT clip with the object in the zone the manifest names. Never improvise a different placement, never skip a zone, never reorder.

detector.vocabulary: the same fixed 62-class THOR_PICKUPABLE_TYPES prompt list as the simulator battery, unchanged
detector.iou_disclosure: No IoU / instance-association gate. Every simulator run binds a detection to a rendered instance mask before it may become a claim, which makes detector hallucinations incapable of creating a sighting. Real footage has no instance masks, so that gate is absent here: a hallucinated detection CAN produce a false sighting and a wrong commitment. That is the point of the test - it is strictly harder than the simulator batteries on precisely the axis reviewers doubt.

grading: An episode is CORRECT when the engine's committed zone equals truth_zone. A commitment to any other zone is WRONG (it is not a miss). No commitment inside the visit budget is a MISS. Wrong commitments and misses are reported separately.
engine_unchanged: The engine is used unmodified; only the sense model in experiments/embodied/phone_find.py is new.
